changeSet.author: lifefit-architecture
changeSet.comment: Ticket: LF-0033. Extend the gym member profile with emergency relationship, fitness goal, assigned trainer, and private photo metadata. The photo file stays outside SQL Server. Index review: PK_MemberProfiles and IX_MemberProfiles_TenantId_Status already serve tenant lists, status filters, and join-date order; UX_MemberProfiles_TenantId_UserId stays the one-profile rule; FK_MemberProfiles_TrainerProfiles and IX_MemberProfiles_AssignedTrainerId support the optional same-tenant trainer link and are filtered to rows that have a trainer. Mobile stays unique on Users.Phone, so no second mobile index is added. Performance note: member search still seeks the tenant status index, then joins the matching users.
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE app.MemberProfiles ADD EmergencyContactRelationship NVARCHAR(64) NULL, FitnessGoal NVARCHAR(32) NULL, AssignedTrainerId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NULL, PhotoStorageKey NVARCHAR(200) NULL, PhotoContentType NVARCHAR(64) NULL, PhotoFileSize INT NULL;
ALTER TABLE app.MemberProfiles ADD CONSTRAINT FK_MemberProfiles_TrainerProfiles FOREIGN KEY (AssignedTrainerId) REFERENCES app.TrainerProfiles (Id);

ALTER TABLE app.MemberProfiles ADD CONSTRAINT CK_MemberProfiles_FitnessGoal CHECK (FitnessGoal IS NULL OR FitnessGoal IN (N'FatLoss', N'MuscleGain', N'Strength', N'Endurance', N'GeneralFitness', N'Mobility', N'WeightMaintenance'));
ALTER TABLE app.MemberProfiles ADD CONSTRAINT CK_MemberProfiles_PhotoFileSize CHECK (PhotoFileSize IS NULL OR PhotoFileSize > 0);
CREATE INDEX IX_MemberProfiles_AssignedTrainerId ON app.MemberProfiles (AssignedTrainerId) WHERE AssignedTrainerId IS NOT NULL AND DeletedAt IS NULL;
